in vec2 vUV;out vec4 O;uniform sampler2D uImage;uniform vec2 uDirection;uniform int uThreshold;
void main(){vec3 c=vec3(0);float weights[5]=float[5](.227027,.1945946,.1216216,.054054,.016216);for(int i=-4;i<=4;i++){vec3 a=texture(uImage,vUV+uDirection*float(i)).rgb;if(uThreshold==1)a=max(a-vec3(.65),vec3(0));c+=a*weights[abs(i)];}O=vec4(c,1.);}
emberInit: layout(location=0)out vec4 P;layout(location=1)out vec4 V;void main(){P=vec4(0,0,0,-1);V=vec4(0);}

precision highp float;in vec3 vEmber;in vec2 vDirection;in float vStretch;out vec4 O;
 void main(){vec2 p=gl_PointCoord-.5;float along=dot(p,vDirection),across=dot(p,vec2(-vDirection.y,vDirection.x));float d=length(vec2(along,across*vStretch));float a=exp(-d*d*18.)*(1.-smoothstep(.36,.5,d));O=vec4(vEmber*a,0);}
